signed_rows.behavior: Every uses: line in action.yml pins a 40-character commit SHA followed by a # vX.Y.Z comment.
signed_rows.fails_when: any uses: line in action.yml has a tag or branch ref, or no version comment
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/scripts/test_workflows.py -q -k 'test_every_action_is_pinned_by_commit_sha and action'

signed_rows.behavior: Every uses: line in .github/workflows/knowledge-audit.yml pins a 40-character commit SHA followed by a # vX.Y.Z comment.
signed_rows.fails_when: any uses: line in knowledge-audit.yml has a tag or branch ref, or no version comment
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/scripts/test_workflows.py -q -k 'test_every_action_is_pinned_by_commit_sha and knowledge'

signed_rows.behavior: Each pinned SHA is the commit of the release its comment names, and the same action runs at one version across action.yml and the repo's workflows.
signed_rows.fails_when: a SHA does not match its tag upstream, or one action is pinned at two versions
